privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.intro: How we collect, use, store, share and protect your personal information.
privacy-policy.body:
This Privacy Policy (“Policy”) describes how Homeasy Automation Private Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, bearing CIN: U74909BR2025PTC073219, and having its registered office at B-Hub, 5th Floor, A Block, Mauryalok Complex, Patna – 800001, Bihar, India (hereinafter referred to as “Homeasy,” “we,” “our,” or “us”), collects, uses, stores, shares, and protects your personal information when you access or use our website, mobile application, hardware devices, and related services (“Services”). By using our Services, you consent to the collection, processing, and use of your personal information in accordance with this Policy.

## 1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following categories of information:

### a. Personally Identifiable Information (PII)

- Full name, email address, phone number, billing and shipping addresses
- Account login details and credentials.
- Payment details (processed securely through third-party gateways).

### b. Sensitive Personal Data or Information (SPDI)

- Financial details for payment processing.
- Device configuration, automation preferences, and usage logs from connected smart devices. (SPDI is collected and processed only as required under the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011.)

### c. Technical & Device Information

- IP address, browser type, operating system, unique device identifiers.
- Log data, and application usage statistics.

### d. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

- We use cookies, web beacons, and similar tools to enhance user experience and for analytics.

## 2. Purpose of Collection & Use of Data

We process your data only for lawful purposes, including:

- To provide, personalize, and improve our Services.
- To process orders, payments, and subscriptions.
- To enable device integration and automation features.
- To send transactional, service-related, or promotional communications (with your consent).
- To comply with applicable legal, regulatory, or contractual obligations.

## 3. Consent

- By using our Services, you expressly consent to the collection and processing of your personal data.
- You may withdraw consent at any time by contacting us (see Section 10). However, withdrawal may affect our ability to provide Services.

## 4. Data Retention

- We retain personal information only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Policy, comply with legal requirements, or resolve disputes.
- Upon request, we will delete or anonymize your personal data, unless retention is required under law.

## 5. Data Sharing & Disclosure

We do not sell your personal information. We may share your data only with:

- Service Providers: Payment processors, cloud hosting, analytics partners.
- Business Partners: For authorized integrations or value-added services.
- Legal & Regulatory Authorities: If required by law, court order, or government request.
- Corporate Transactions: In case of mergers, acquisitions, or transfer of business.

## 6. Data Security

- We adopt reasonable security practices and procedures as mandated under Rule 8 of the SPDI Rules, including encryption, firewalls, and secure servers.
- While we strive to protect your data, no method of electronic storage or transmission is 100% secure.

## 7. User Rights

As per applicable law, you have the right to:

- Access, correct, update your personal information.
- Request deletion of your personal data.
- Restrict or object to data processing
- Withdraw consent at any time.
- Request a copy of your personal data in a portable format.

To exercise your rights, you may contact us at the details provided in Section 10.

## 8. Children’s Privacy

Our Services are not intended for individuals below 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If such data is inadvertently collected, it will be deleted.

## 9. Updates to This Policy

We may update this Policy from time to time. Updates will be posted on our website with the “Last Updated” date. Continued use of Services constitutes acceptance of the revised Policy.

## 10. Grievance Officer & Contact Information

In compliance with Rule 5(9) of the SPDI Rules, 2011, we have designated a Grievance Officer for data protection concerns:

Name of Grievance Officer: Aditya Kumar
Designation: Grievance Officer – Data Privacy & Compliance
Email: [aditya@homeasy.io](mailto:aditya@homeasy.io)
Registered Office: Homeasy Automation Private Limited, CIN: U74909BR2025PTC073219, B-Hub, 5th Floor, A Block, Mauryalok Complex, Patna – 800001, Bihar, India.

The Grievance Officer shall acknowledge grievances within 24 hours and resolve them within 15 working days.

## Disclaimer

This policy is a binding agreement between you and Homeasy Automation Private Limited. Homeasy reserves the right to amend or update this policy at any time. Changes will be posted on our website, and continued use of our services will be deemed as acceptance.

terms-of-service.title: Terms of service
terms-of-service.intro: The terms for using this website and for our surveys, quotes and installations.
terms-of-service.body:
## 1. About these terms

This website is run by Homeasy Automation Private Limited (CIN U74909BR2025PTC073219), registered office at {address}, India. In these terms, "Homeasy", "we" and "us" mean this company.

By using this website or booking a survey, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the website. When you place an order, your written quote and order confirmation also apply. If they differ from these terms, the quote and order confirmation take priority.

## 2. Using this website

- You may use this website for personal or business enquiries about Homeasy.
- Please give us accurate details, so we can reach you and serve you properly.
- You must not misuse the website. This includes trying to gain unauthorised access, sending spam, or interfering with how it works.

## 3. Information on this website

We try to keep this website accurate and up to date. Homeasy is at a pre-launch stage. Features, products and services marked "Coming soon" or "Planned" are not yet available and may change or may not be released. The roadmap shows current plans only.

Images and 3D scenes on this website are illustrations. Actual modules and installations may look different. Whether a Homeasy module can be fitted depends on your switchboxes and wiring, which we check at the survey.

## 4. Home survey

- The home survey is free within our survey service area, which is currently Bihar.
- A survey request is not a confirmed booking until we confirm a visit time with you.
- An adult must be present during the visit and give us safe access to the switchboards.
- Having a survey does not oblige you to buy anything.
- The survey is a visual check of the switchboxes and wiring we are shown. It is not a full electrical safety inspection of your property.

## 5. Quotes and prices

- After the survey, we give you a written quote for the work you have asked for.
- The quote states what is included, the price, the taxes that apply and how long the quote is valid.
- If we find at installation that extra work is needed which could not be seen at the survey, we will tell you and agree any change with you before we continue.
- Any prices shown on this website are indicative. Your exact price is confirmed after the survey.

## 6. Orders and payments

An order is placed when you accept our written quote and we confirm it. The payment schedule and the payment methods we accept will be stated on your quote or invoice. We will give you a tax invoice for every payment where the law requires one.

## 7. Installation

- Installation is carried out by Homeasy technicians on the date agreed with you.
- Please make sure an adult is present, that we have access to the switchboards, and that power can be switched off while we work.
- Homeasy modules are fitted inside your existing switchboxes. If a switchbox or its wiring is unsuitable or unsafe, we may decline to install there and will explain why.
- You remain responsible for the condition of your home's existing wiring, switches and appliances, except for damage caused by our work.
- Modules should not be opened, moved or reinstalled by anyone other than Homeasy. Doing so may affect your warranty.

## 8. Cancellations and refunds

- You can cancel or reschedule a survey at any time, at no cost, by WhatsApp or phone.
- The cancellation and refund terms for a paid order will be set out in your quote and order confirmation before you pay.
- These terms are being finalised and this section will be updated before we take our first order.

## 9. Warranty and support

Homeasy modules carry a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects, from the date of installation. The full terms, including what is not covered and how to claim, are on our [Warranty](/warranty) page. For support, contact us on WhatsApp or phone during working hours ({hours}).

## 10. The Homeasy app

The Homeasy app has not been launched. It is coming soon. When it is released, separate app terms will apply and will be published before you use it. App control depends on your Wi-Fi, internet and phone, which are outside our control.

## 11. Intellectual property

The Homeasy name, logo, website content and designs belong to Homeasy or its licensors. You may not copy or use them for commercial purposes without our written permission.

## 12. Privacy

Our [Privacy policy](/privacy-policy) explains how we handle your personal data.

## 13. Third-party services and links

This website links to services run by others, such as WhatsApp, Google Maps and social media sites. We are not responsible for their content, availability or terms.

## 14. Our liability

- We will carry out surveys and installations with reasonable care and skill.
- To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for problems caused by pre-existing faults in your wiring, power supply, appliances, internet connection or third-party devices.
- To the extent the law allows, our total liability for an order is limited to the amount you paid us for that order.
- Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, or removes your rights as a consumer under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

## 15. Governing law and disputes

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Please contact us first so we can try to resolve any issue directly. Subject to your rights under consumer law, the courts at Patna, Bihar will have jurisdiction.

## 16. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms as our services develop. The latest version will always be on this page, with the date it was last updated. Changes do not affect orders already confirmed.

## 17. Contact and grievances

For questions or complaints about these terms or our services, write to:

Grievance Officer, Homeasy Automation Private Limited
{address}, India
Email: [{email}](mailto:{email})

You can also call or WhatsApp us on {phone} during working hours ({hours}).

refund-policy.title: Refund and cancellation policy
refund-policy.intro: The Homeasy refund policy: how to cancel an order, when a refund applies, and how it is paid.
refund-policy.body:
## 1. Who this applies to

This policy covers orders placed on homeasy.io with Homeasy Automation Private Limited (CIN U74909BR2025PTC073219), registered office at {address}, India.

## 2. Cancelling an order

- You can cancel an order at any time before it is dispatched or installed. We refund the full amount you paid.
- To cancel, WhatsApp or call us on {phone}, or email {email}, with your order number.
- Once a module has been installed in your home, the order can no longer be cancelled. Faults are handled under our warranty.

## 3. Booking amounts

- A booking amount confirms your order. The balance is due before delivery or installation.
- If our survey finds that your switchboxes or wiring are not suitable, we refund the booking amount in full.
- If you cancel before dispatch or installation, we refund the booking amount in full.

## 4. Returns

- You can return a module that has not been installed or used, in its original packaging. The return period is stated in your order confirmation.
- If a module arrives damaged or is not what you ordered, tell us as soon as you can, with photos. We replace it or refund you.
- Modules that have been installed, opened up or damaged after delivery cannot be returned for a refund.

## 5. Faulty modules

Homeasy modules carry a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. A faulty module is replaced under the [warranty](/warranty).

## 6. How refunds are paid

- Refunds go back to the payment method you used, through our payment partner Razorpay.
- After we approve a refund, banks usually take 5 to 7 working days to show it in your account.
- We do not charge a fee for a refund that this policy allows.

## 7. Contact

Questions about a cancellation or refund: {phone} (phone and WhatsApp), {email}. Working hours: {hours}.

delivery-policy.title: Delivery policy
delivery-policy.intro: Where we deliver, how delivery is arranged, and what it costs.
delivery-policy.body:
## 1. Who this applies to

This policy covers orders placed on homeasy.io with Homeasy Automation Private Limited (CIN U74909BR2025PTC073219), registered office at {address}, India.

## 2. Where we deliver

We deliver across Bihar. The checkout page tells you if your pincode is outside our delivery area.

## 3. When your order arrives

- After you order, we call or WhatsApp you to confirm the delivery date.
- Delivery time depends on your location and on stock. We tell you the expected date before we dispatch.
- If we cannot deliver an item, we tell you and refund what you paid for it.

## 4. Delivery charges

Any delivery charge is shown in your cart before you pay. There are no delivery charges added later.

- Homeasy modules go inside your electrical switchbox. We recommend installation by our trained electricians.

- Electrical work carries risk. Do not open a switchbox yourself unless you are a qualified electrician.

## 6. Receiving your order

- Please check the package when it arrives.
- If anything is damaged or missing, tell us as soon as you can, with photos. See our [refund and cancellation policy](/refund-policy).

## 7. Contact

Questions about a delivery: {phone} (phone and WhatsApp), {email}. Working hours: {hours}.

cookie-policy.title: Cookie policy
cookie-policy.intro: What cookies are, what this website uses today, and how you stay in control.
cookie-policy.body:
## 1. Who we are

This website is run by Homeasy Automation Private Limited (CIN U74909BR2025PTC073219), registered office at {address}, India.

## 2. What cookies are

Cookies are small text files that a website saves in your browser. They help a site remember your choices or understand how it is used. Similar technologies, such as local storage, work in a comparable way. This policy covers all of them.

## 3. What this website uses today

- This site currently sets no analytics cookies.
- This site sets no advertising or tracking cookies.
- We do not use cookies to build a profile of you or to show you targeted ads.

## 4. What may change, and how you will be asked

We plan to use Google Analytics to understand, in aggregate, which pages are useful. It is not enabled today. Once enabled, it will run only after you give consent.

- You will see a clear choice to accept or refuse analytics cookies.
- If you refuse, analytics will not load and the site will work the same way.
- We will need to store your choice in your browser, so we do not ask you on every page.

## 5. Types of cookies, purpose and duration

### Strictly necessary

Purpose: to remember your cookie choice and keep forms secure. These do not need consent because the site cannot work properly without them. They are not used to track you.

### Analytics (only with your consent)

Purpose: to count visits and see which pages are used, so we can improve the site. These are set by Google Analytics and are not in use today.

Before any of these cookies is switched on, we will list each one on this page with its name, purpose and how long it lasts.

## 6. Third-party sites

This website links to WhatsApp, Google Maps and our social media pages. We do not embed them here. If you follow a link, that site may set its own cookies under its own policy.

## 7. How to refuse or remove cookies

- Once the consent choice is live, you can refuse analytics cookies there and change your mind later.
- You can block or delete cookies at any time in your browser settings.
- Blocking analytics cookies will not stop you using this website.

## 8. More information

Our [Privacy policy](/privacy-policy) explains how we handle personal data and your rights under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

## 9. Contact

For questions about cookies on this website, write to:

Grievance Officer, Homeasy Automation Private Limited
{address}, India
Email: [{email}](mailto:{email})

## 10. Changes to this policy

We will update this page before any new cookie is used. The latest version will always be here, with the date it was last updated.
